people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.
translations.bsb: Now when Saul’s watchmen at Gibeah in Benjamin looked and saw the troops melting away and scattering in every direction,
translations.kjv: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.
translations.asv: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went hither and thither.
